PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 9:00 AM, President Scott called the meeting to order.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Dennis Santos, Manager of Water Engineering, Utilities Department, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott

CONSENT CALENDAR

A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Vice President Cordero, to
approve Consent Calendar Items 1-3. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  0  None

1.  26-54743  Recommendation to approve March 19, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Vice President
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Absent:  0 None

2.  26-54744  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for April 2, 2026.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Vice President
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  26-54745  Recommendation to approve Retirement Order No. 6195 for inventory items that
  are no long being used during the current year.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Vice President
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

REGULAR AGENDA

4.  26-54746  Recommendation to receive and file Bay-Delta Project Update.

  A motion was made by Vice President Cordero, seconded by Commissioner
  Maguire, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  President Scott introduced Dr. Maureen Martin, Manager of Bay-Delta Science and
  Regulatory Strategy, Metropolitan Water District of Southern California.

  Page 2 of 7
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, introduced Agenda Item 4
  and invited Dr. Martin to provide the report.

  Dr. Martin spoke; and provided a PowerPoint presentation.

  Vice President Cordero spoke.

  Dr. Martin, Manager of Bay-Delta Science and Regulatory Strategy, Metropolitan
  Water District of Southern California, spoke.

  Vice President Cordero spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Vice President Cordero and Dr. Martin, Manager of
  Bay-Delta Science and Regulatory Strategy, Metropolitan Water District of Southern
  California.

5.  26-54747  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-26-313 and award a contract with
  Los Angeles Truck Centers, LLC, (dba Velocity Truck Centers) for the purchase of
  original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts and repair services for heavy-duty
  fleet vehicles on an as-needed basis, in an annual amount not to exceed $100,000
  for a one-year period, with options to renew for up to two additional one-year
  periods, and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary
  to enter into the contract, including any necessary subsequent
  amendments.

  A motion was made by Secretary Parkin, seconded by Commissioner Austin,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

6.  26-54750  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1549 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract, and any necessary subsequent amendments, with
  Quinn Power Systems Associates, as the authorized distributor for Caterpillar, Inc.,
  for the purchase and delivery of one (1) natural gas standby generator on the
  same terms and conditions specified in the Sourcewell Cooperative Purchasing
  Agreement with Caterpillar, Inc. (Contract No. 92222-CAT), in a total amount not to
  exceed $226,593 until the Sourcewell Contract expires on November 22, 2027,
  with the option to renew for as long as the Sourcewell Contract is in effect, at the
  discretion of the General Manager.

  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Vice President
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

7.  26-54751  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to enter into an agreement, including any necessary subsequent
  amendments, with CP VI Marketplace, LLC, for the relocation and construction of
  potable water mains, including all associated appurtenances for the housing
  project located at 6615 E. Pacific Coast Highway, at no cost to the Long Beach
  Public Utilities Department.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Commissioner
  Maguire, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Dennis Santos, Manager of Water Engineering, Utilities Department, spoke; and
  provided a PowerPoint presentation.

  Vice President Cordero spoke.

  Dennis Santos, Manager of Water Engineering, Utilities Department, spoke.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

  Vice President Cordero spoke.

  Secretary Parkin spoke.

  Dennis Santos, Manager of Water Engineering, Utilities Department, spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Secretary Parkin and Dennis Santos, Manager of
  Water Engineering, Utilities Department.

  Page 4 of 7
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

8.  26-54752  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1550 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract, and any necessary documents including
  subsequent amendments, with Haaker Equipment Company for the purchase of
  manufacturer-authorized replacement OEM parts and services for video pipeline
  inspection equipment; high-pressure jetting systems equipment; and vehicle broom
  sweeper equipment, in an annual amount not to exceed $200,000 for a one-year
  period, with the option to renew for two additional one-year periods.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Vice President
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Mike Herrbach, Manager of Sewer Operations, Utilities Department, spoke; and
  provided a PowerPoint presentation.

  Commissioner Austin spoke.

  Mike Herrbach, Manager of Sewer Operations, Utilities Department, spoke.

9.  26-54753  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-26-307 and award a contract to Los
  Angeles Truck Centers, LLC, dba Velocity Truck Centers, for the purchase and
  delivery of one compressed natural gas (CNG) 10-yard dump truck, in a total
  amount not to exceed $400,000, and authorize the General Manager to enter into
  the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  A motion was made by Vice President Cordero, seconded by Commissioner
  Austin, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

10. 26-54754  Recommendation to receive and file March 19, 2026 Finance Committee Report.

  Page 5 of 7
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  A motion was made by Secretary Parkin, seconded by Commissioner
  Maguire, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Secretary Parkin provided a verbal report.

  President Scott spoke.

11. 26-54755  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Report.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Maguire, seconded by Vice President
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, provided a verbal report.

  President Scott spoke.

CLOSED SESSION

26-54756  Pending Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel relating to liability
  claims pursuant to subparagraph (2) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 of the
  California Government Code: Government Tort Claim of Eugene Triff, Valerie Triff
  and/or Triff Family Trust (C25-0494).

26-54757  Pending Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel relating to liability
  claims pursuant to subparagraph (2) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 of the
  California Government Code: United Services Automobile Association (USAA) (C25-
  0686).

  President Scott read the Closed Session items into the record and requested public
  comments. No public comments were received on either item.

  Page 6 of 7
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  The Board recessed to Closed Session at 9:52 AM and reconvened at 10:18 AM.

  Adam Jacobs, Deputy City Attorney, City of Long Beach, reported out on the two
  Closed Session items.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There were no comments received from the public.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

President Scott spoke.

ADJOURNMENT

At 10:20 AM, President Scott adjourned the meeting.

NOTE:

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking
persons is desired, please make your request by phone to the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-
6101, 72 business hours prior to the Commission meeting.

telepono sa Opisina ng Clerk ng Lungsod sa (562) 570-6101, 72 oras ng negosyo bago ang
pagpupulong ng Commission.

Si desea obtener la traducción escrita en otro idioma de la agenda y actas de la comisión para
personas que no hablan inglés, haga su solicitud por teléfono a la Oficina de la Secretaría Municipal
al (562) 570-6101, 72 horas hábiles antes de la reunión de la comisión.
